card.name: Word right after a comma mid-sentence
card.fires_on: The word straight after a comma that follows a long subject or clause, such as a verb or conjunction (are, when, if, either, et). Mostly in general prose, not drug text.

modes.description: A verb or linking word follows a comma that closes a long opening phrase or clause.
